title: 2.3.29 Convert an if-chain to switch
description: Rewrite an if/else-if chain as a switch statement with at least two cases, a default, and break. Auto-graded.
sourceRef: designed: practice converting an if/else-if chain to switch, ahead of 2.3.30 A2.3.1 Print Settings Advisor

steps.title: Create a variable to switch on
steps.instructions: Create a variable called day and assign it a day-of-week string, for example 'Monday'.

steps.title: Write a switch statement
steps.instructions: Write a switch statement that checks the value of day. Include at least two case labels (for example 'Monday' and 'Friday'), a default label, and a break statement after each case body. Inside each case, use console.log to print a message for that day.
